v0.2.0.description:
Changelog:

New Features and Tracking:

    Added enemy and player stat tracking system for location completion: bosses, minibosses, regular enemies, destructible objects, pit falls, and player deaths.

Fixes and Improvements:

    Fixed location ID desynchronization between the mod and the apworld.

    Fixed certain location names that were not triggering in-game.

    Refined and adjusted parameters for several locations.

    Fixed final completion condition on the apworld side.

    General code cleanup.
v0.2.0.title: v0.2.0

v0.4.0.description:
### Added
* Implemented Archipelago location checks for NPCs: Doctor Song, Savile the Tailor, Nox the Unfortunate, Nocturne the Cardist, Cremire the Collector, Doki the Banker, and Strange Time Keeper.
* Unlocked run looping via the Strange Time Keeper without requiring a previous game clear.

### Fixes
* Corrected multiple location names.

### Refactoring
* General code refactoring and optimization.
v0.4.0.title: v0.4.0

v0.5.0.description:
## Added

* **Archipelago Item Reception**: Full support for receiving incoming items from other players. Relics and Arcanas are now properly granted and unlocked upon receipt.
* **Cursed Traps**: Implemented trap handling for incoming Archipelago traps. Receiving a trap will randomly trigger one of two outcomes:
  * Grants a **Cursed Relic** directly to your inventory while inflicting **100 HP damage** (safeguarded to leave the player at 1 HP minimum).
  * Spawns a random group of enemies directly around the player.

## Fixed

* **Boss Chest Looting**: Disabled Arcana drops from Boss Chests to enforce progression exclusively through Archipelago items.
v0.5.0.title: v0.5.0

v0.6.0.description:
## Added

* **Skill Slot Locking System**: Implemented logic to dynamically restrict and lock skill slots based on player Archipelago progression.
* **Elemental License Restrictions**: Added logic enforcing Element Licenses, requiring players to acquire the corresponding license before equipping or using elemental Arcanas based on player yaml options.
* **YAML-Based Starting Inventory**: Integrated starting inventory assignment determined by player yaml options (`StartingArcanaMode` and `ElementLicensesMode`).
* **Steam Achievements Safeguard**: Disabled Steam Achievements during Archipelago runs to maintain vanilla achievement integrity.

## Changed

* **DataManager Refactor**: Replaced `StatsManager` with `DataManager` to centralize Archipelago data, used to prevent reapplying starting inventory.

## Fixed

* **Dungeon NPC Events**: Fixed an issue where dungeon NPC events failed to trigger.
* **Multi-Session Item Processing**: Resolved a bug where starting or loading a new Archipelago run directly after a previous one caused errors with incoming items.
v0.6.0.title: v0.6.0

v0.7.0.description:
## Added

* **Elemental Biome Keys & Checks**: Introduced new key items that unlock elemental biomes (Fire, Water, Air, Earth, Lightning) within the dungeon, along with biome-specific locations and checks.

## Changed

* **Location Logic Rework**: Overhauled the logic system to implement soft logic on grindy checks, preventing early-game cluttering in Sphere 1 and improving overall progression pacing.
v0.7.0.title: v0.7.0

v0.8.0.description:
## Added

* **Relic Slot Upgrade**: Introduced new relic slot upgrade item to allow player start the dungeon with more than one relic and ease difficulty.

## Changed

* **Epic Beard Wizard NPC**: Remove interaction with the wizard NPC to prevent breaking elemental biome spawn logic in dungeon.
v0.8.0.title: v0.8.0

v0.9.0.description:
## Added
- Implemented Bouncy Castle to create a local proxy for joining distant Archipelago servers requiring TLS 1.2 or 1.3.
- Added new location checks:
  - "Perfect a Boss" achievement
  - Have 1000 gold
  - Have 500 chaos gems

## Changed
- Rebalanced locations and items.
- Reworked the Relic Slot Upgrade item: locks relic pickup in dungeons if no slot is available it replaces one you have, but allows equipping relics in the hub when a slot is open to ease the game.
- Reverted the DoctorNPC patch to restore its normal behavior.

## Fixed
- **Biome Handling:** Fixed synchronization with the loading screen and ensured the biome shuffle is set only at the start of a dungeon run.
- **Shuffler NPC:** Fixed interaction triggering twice instead of once.
- **Spellbook:** Prevented equipping skills if the corresponding element license is not unlocked in element license mode.
v0.9.0.title: v0.9.0

v1.0.0.description:
## [1.0.0] - V1.0.0 Release

### Added
- Complete project documentation, including repository `README.md`, setup guide (`setup_en.md`), and Archipelago world documentation (`en_WizardOfLegend.md`).

### Changed
- Global codebase refactor to improve overall architecture, readability, and maintainability.
- Added extensive inline code comments across most of the project.

### Fixed
- Various minor bug fixes and general stability improvements.

### AI Disclosure
- AI assistance was used for learning BepInEx/Harmony modding patterns, setting up the TLS 1.2/1.3 proxy, and supporting code refactoring. The vast majority of the codebase was authored by hand..
v1.0.0.title: v1.0.0
